description.p: Lenta puts the games of Steam, Heroic, Lutris and Hydra on one ribbon of cards, fully usable with a gamepad as well as the keyboard and mouse.

ul.li: A ribbon of covers or wide capsules with tilt, reflection and glow, the selected game's art behind it
Game pages with the store description, achievements, screenshots and play time
Library tabs per launcher and own collections across all of them, plain or by rules
Launch options kept in step with Steam and Lutris
Running games shown on the Play button, closed from the pad; Steam's updates shown with their progress
Proton versions per game, art from SteamGridDB, older game versions from Steam, more of them pasted from SteamDB
Steam games installed, moved between libraries and drives, and uninstalled; Heroic, Lutris and Hydra games uninstalled
Power off, restart and log out from the side panel
Own Windows programs: installers run in prefixes made here with Proton (through umu) or Wine, the program to run found, libraries through winetricks at one press
External modules: own sections and per-game settings (a MangoHud example included)
A mod manager module: mods from archives and Nexus Mods, linked into games without copying

Mods module: a mod manager on a game's page — mods from archives (Unreal paks, UE4SS Lua/C++ mods, UE4SS itself, BepInEx plugins) linked into the game, on and off at once, the game's own files kept; mods put in by hand shown and toggled
Nexus Mods: API key, "Mod Manager Download" links open in Lenta, update checks
DLL mods (UE4SS, ReShade, OptiScaler, BepInEx…) let load: by themselves for own programs, in the prefix for other games
Environment variables for own programs
Modules' tabs on a game's page gathered into one "Modules" tab
Libraries at one press for any game with a prefix: Steam's through protontricks, Heroic's, Lutris's and Hydra's through winetricks; sets already there ticked
More sets: older Visual C++ 2005–2013, DirectX 10/11 and XInput, PhysX
Card shape set apart for Home and the Library
Add and Prefixes tiles as big as the game cards
Own programs: install and run Windows programs in Wine prefixes made here, with Proton through umu or the system Wine
Prefixes: create, choose Proton or Wine, libraries through winetricks at one press, winecfg, run a file once
The program to run found after an install from its shortcuts or new files, or picked by hand
A file browser for the pad, or the system file window
Installers drawn through Wine's Wayland driver: no empty white window behind them
Hydra Launcher games; Heroic games owned but not installed
Install, move and uninstall Steam games; Steam libraries in Settings
Uninstall Heroic, Lutris and Hydra games
Older versions from tables pasted from SteamDB
Touchpad swipes between tabs; power off, restart and log out
